symptom: `group g1 (Caption: 'Group one')` inside an Accordion passes `mxcli check`, `exec` reports "Created page", and `describe` shows the group with the package default `headerText: 'Header'` — the caption is gone. Same silence for `designproperties:` on a DataGrid 2 `column` and `attributeValue:` on an HTMLElement `attribute`
cause: Object-list items were exempt from both unknown-property checks (`validateStaticWidgetUnknownProps`, `validatePluggableWidgetProperties`) with a comment saying the object-list engine validates them, but `buildObjectListItem` only walks the item SCHEMA and looks each key up in the MDL bag — a key matching no schema property or alias is never visited and never reported
insight: Derive the item vocabulary from the mapping — schema keys, `MdlAliases`, and `<name>Params` for each texttemplate under either spelling, plus a chart series' friendly `DataSource:` — and do NOT reuse the top-level `isBuiltinPropName` allowance: `Caption`/`Class` being accepted universally is the hole. The Accordion definition is generated from the project's .mpk, so a test with `LoadWidgetRegistry("")` has no mapping and passes vacuously; copy the .mpk from `testdata/pedapp/widgets` into a temp project. Measure false positives by sweeping every repo .mdl with `check -p` (base vs new binary) against a project holding the stock packages: all 6 new reports were real drops (verified by exec + bson dump), 3 of them in doctype/bug-test examples that taught the drop. Edit distance answers a truncated key badly (`attributeValue` -> `attributeName`); prefer candidates that extend the key. Issue #891 (ako/mxcli#1274)
